zwo_asi462_v1_1.title: ZWO ASI462 Manual EN V1.1
zwo_asi462_v1_1.scope: Complete ASI462MC camera performance; Sony IMX462 sensor.
zwo_asi462_v1_1.method: Manually read paired markers on page 7; all operating-point values from the same chart.
zwo_asi462_v1_1.redistribution: Only factual extracted parameters and source digest are bundled; source PDF is not redistributed.

zwo_asi662_v1_0.title: ZWO ASI662 Manual EN V1.0
zwo_asi662_v1_0.scope: Complete original ASI662MC camera performance; Sony IMX662AAQR-C sensor.
zwo_asi662_v1_0.method: Manually read paired markers on page 7. Low-gain FWC and maximum RN are also in page 5. HCG fullwell derives from chart electrons/ADU times 4096.
zwo_asi662_v1_0.revision_warning: This V1.0 MC manual says HCG starts at vendor gain 252; the later combined MC/MM product page says 200. Profiles deliberately pin V1.0 and do not combine revisions.
zwo_asi662_v1_0.redistribution: Only factual extracted parameters and source digest are bundled; source PDF is not redistributed.

sony_imx307_flyer_2018.title: Sony IMX307LQD/LQR Flyer02 (2017/2018)
sony_imx307_flyer_2018.method: Supports ADC 10/12-bit modes. Saturation and sensitivity are in digital units; absent e-/DN conversion prevents electron fullwell or read-noise extraction.
sony_imx307_flyer_2018.redistribution: Only factual scope and digest are bundled; source PDF is not redistributed.

zwo_asi662_page_20260905.title: ZWO ASI662MC/MM combined product page, accessed 2026-09-05
zwo_asi662_page_20260905.scope: Noise-definition and revision-conflict evidence only. No numeric operating-point values are taken from this changing combined-model page.
zwo_asi662_page_20260905.method: Camera Curve section explicitly includes ADC quantization in read noise and states HCG register200. V1.0 calibration retains its own register252 transition.
zwo_asi662_page_20260905.redistribution: Only factual scope and source digest are bundled; HTML is not redistributed.
